commits.message: Interactive terminal, AI planning and ticket notifications
Company filters for tickets and devices
Ticket lifecycle and company assignment improvements
Deployment checks for running multiple instances

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Interactive terminal, AI planning and ticket notifications
activities.description: Improved the device terminal experience, expanded AI planning and added ticket notifications. Updated the related interface and verification checks.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Company filters for tickets and devices
activities.description: Added company filters to ticket and device views. Improved how company information appears on tickets and checked the updated console workflows.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Ticket lifecycle and company assignment improvements
activities.description: Improved tracking of ticket responses, resolutions and reopenings. Unified ticket categories and refined company assignment and filtering.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Deployment checks for running multiple instances
activities.description: Expanded deployment options for multiple application instances and updated the corresponding acceptance checks.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Restart recovery and session continuity
activities.description: Improved recovery after application restarts and coordination between running instances. Added checks for interrupted operations and session continuity.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Deployment scripts prepared for execution
activities.description: Adjusted deployment script permissions so installation and maintenance tasks can run as intended.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Build pipeline configuration corrected
activities.description: Corrected a configuration formatting issue that prevented an automated build check from running.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Container deployment and backup improvements
activities.description: Added a container-based deployment setup, backup and restore tooling, and deployment documentation. Extended automated deployment checks.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Environment diagnostics added
activities.description: Added an environment diagnostics tool to help check service readiness and configuration. Included verification for both successful and unsuccessful checks.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Service health and startup improvements
activities.description: Added service health checks and structured operational logging. Improved startup, shutdown and initial setup behavior.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Release acceptance checklist updated
activities.description: Updated the manual release checklist with checks for completed implementation milestones.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Agent connection verification expanded
activities.description: Expanded automated checks for endpoint communication and device enrollment. Updated the related connection documentation.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Endpoint communication protection improved
activities.description: Strengthened validation of incoming endpoint messages and secure connection handling. Added automated verification for the updated behavior.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Device communication security improved
activities.description: Improved protection of device communication and enrollment credentials. Updated compatibility handling for endpoint releases.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Unused code removed
activities.description: Removed unused interface components, outdated automation code and temporary development utilities to simplify maintenance.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: More reproducible dependency installs
activities.description: Pinned dependency versions to make installations more consistent. Verified the affected interface builds.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Automated quality checks expanded
activities.description: Expanded automated server and endpoint checks and dependency auditing. Updated dependencies and improved test setup consistency.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Workflow test isolation improved
activities.description: Separated automated workflow test jobs from ordinary background processing to reduce inconsistent test results.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Access-control verification corrected
activities.description: Corrected automated checks for console access, permissions and organisation boundaries. Aligned the checks with the current application behavior.

commits.message: Console, reporting and support chat improvements
AI insights planning and scheduling improved
Endpoint maintenance and patch reporting expanded
Technician permissions and console access refined

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Implementation and deployment documentation updated
activities.description: Consolidated implementation planning documents and removed outdated specifications. Updated deployment exclusions.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Console, reporting and support chat improvements
activities.description: Added reporting views and configurable overview layouts. Improved ticket navigation, support chat handoff, device diagnostics and interface consistency.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: AI insights planning and scheduling improved
activities.description: Updated AI insights planning, department scope and scheduling. Refined the related settings and interface.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Dashboard charts and legends expanded
activities.description: Added radial chart variations, chart patterns and legends. Improved chart animation and ticket activity visualisation.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Endpoint maintenance and patch reporting expanded
activities.description: Expanded endpoint update and maintenance capabilities. Improved patch reports, inventory integration and automated endpoint checks.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Additional verification for privileged actions
activities.description: Added additional identity verification for privileged device operations and refined the associated sign-in experience.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Technician permissions and console access refined
activities.description: Aligned technician permissions with console page access. Expanded checks that users can access only the features available to their role.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Application security improvements
activities.description: Improved request handling, auditability and protection of public-facing application features. Expanded automated security checks.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Workflow editor and automation expanded
activities.description: Added a visual workflow editor, organised workflow folders and approval flows. Expanded change planning and vulnerability matching, with related automated checks.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Interface and procurement improvements
activities.description: Refined the console interface, billing visualisations and procurement experience. Updated related views and checks.

activities.author: Artin
activities.title: Development updates consolidated
activities.description: Consolidated development changes while preserving the current application state.
